描述_EN: right side fastening (5 loop and knot buttons); long and wide sleeves, straight cuffs, slit at sides, small stand-up collar and cloud collar sewn on the top of the shoulders.coral satin damask lining with self-patterned flowers. white satin sleeve-bands embroidered with lion, vase, flowers etc.. the trimming take the shape of the ruyitou ( scroll) at the side slits opening. navy blue cut velvet ground with self patterned large butterflies and flowers (prunus, chrysanthemum) scattered on the main body. informal wear. han chinese woman's jacket (ao). the floral pattern and butterflies in the cut pile, the background in uncut pile. the opening flap, the hem and the side slits are also trimmed with a narrow black bias-cut satin band, an heavily embroidered black satin band and an applied warp-patterned ribbon. in couched gold thread and coloured silks in satin stitch and knot stitch. at the neck is an appliqued cloud collar of black satin, embroidered with flowers and a lot of different birds in coloured silks, mainly in satin stitch.
描述_ZN: right side fastening (5 loop and knot buttons); long and wide sleeves, straight cuffs, slit at sides, small stand-up collar and cloud collar sewn on the top of the shoulders.coral satin damask lining with self-patterned flowers. 白缎袖带上绣有狮子、花瓶、花卉等。 边饰在侧缝开口处采取如意头的形状。 藏青色切割天鹅绒地，主体上散布着自带图案的大蝴蝶和花朵（梅花、菊花）。 非正式的磨损。 汉族妇女的外套（Ao）。 剪绒中的花卉图案和蝴蝶，背景为未剪绒。 开襟、下摆和侧边的缝隙也用一条窄的黑色斜切缎带、一条大量刺绣的黑色缎带和一条应用经线图案的丝带来修饰。 用金线和彩色丝线缝制的缎面和结线。 在颈部有一个黑色缎子的贴花云领，用彩色丝线绣着花和很多不同的鸟，主要是用缎子缝制。
